channel.title: UnpackInsurance guides
channel.description: Plain-English guides to US car and home insurance.

item.title: Does Car Insurance Cover Uber and Lyft Driving? Rideshare Insurance Explained
item.description: Why personal car insurance often excludes rideshare driving, how coverage works in each phase of a trip, and how a rideshare endorsement may fill the gaps.

item.title: What Is Gap Insurance and Is It Worth It?
item.description: Gap insurance may cover the difference between your car loan or lease balance and the car's value if it is totaled. Learn when it is worth it.

item.title: How to File a Car Insurance Claim, Step by Step
item.description: What to do after a car accident and how to file an auto claim: documenting the scene, reporting the claim, working with the adjuster, and resolving disputes.

item.title: Upside Down on Your Car Loan? Your Options Explained
item.description: What it means to be upside down on a car loan, why it matters if your car is totaled, and the options that may help, from gap coverage to paying down principal.

item.title: Comprehensive vs. Collision Coverage: What's the Difference?
item.description: The difference between comprehensive and collision car insurance, what each covers, when lenders require them, and how to decide if you need both.

item.title: How Much Car Insurance Do You Really Need?
item.description: State minimums are only a starting point. Learn how to choose liability limits, decide on collision and comprehensive, and match coverage to your finances.

item.title: How to Lower Your Car Insurance Premium
item.description: Practical ways to lower your car insurance premium without dropping coverage you need: compare quotes, adjust deductibles, and ask for discounts.

item.title: Car Insurance for New Drivers: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Car insurance for new and teen drivers: joining a parent's policy vs. buying your own, coverage to consider, and ways to keep costs manageable.

item.title: What Is an SR-22? Who Needs One and How It Works
item.description: An SR-22 is a certificate proving you carry required car insurance. Learn who needs one, how long it lasts, and what happens if it lapses.

item.title: How Long Does an Accident Stay on Your Insurance Record?
item.description: How long accidents, tickets, and claims can affect your car insurance, how your driving record differs from claims history, and how to check both.

item.title: How Car Insurance Deductibles Work
item.description: How car insurance deductibles work for collision and comprehensive claims, when you pay them, how they affect your premium, and how to choose the right amount.

item.title: Does Homeowners Insurance Cover Roof Damage?
item.description: When homeowners insurance may cover roof damage from storms, hail, or fallen trees, when it does not, and how roof age affects your payout.

item.title: Does Homeowners Insurance Cover Water Damage?
item.description: Which water damage homeowners insurance usually covers, such as burst pipes, and what it often excludes, like floods, slow leaks, and sewer backups.

item.title: Condo Insurance (HO-6) Explained
item.description: How condo insurance (HO-6) works alongside your association's master policy, what it covers, how to choose limits, and why loss assessment coverage matters.

item.title: What Is Umbrella Insurance and Do You Need It?
item.description: Umbrella insurance adds liability protection above your home and auto policies. Learn what it covers, what it excludes, and who may need it.

item.title: Renters Insurance Basics: What It Covers and How Much You Need
item.description: Renters insurance can protect your belongings, liability, and living expenses. Learn what it covers, what it excludes, and how to choose limits.

item.title: Home Insurance Deductibles Explained
item.description: Learn how home insurance deductibles work, including flat-dollar and percentage deductibles, wind and hurricane deductibles, and how to choose the right amount.

item.title: How to Compare Car Insurance Quotes Side by Side
item.description: A step-by-step method for comparing car insurance quotes fairly: gather the right details, match coverage, read the fine print, and look past the price.

item.title: Replacement Cost vs. Actual Cash Value: What Homeowners Should Know
item.description: Understand the difference between replacement cost and actual cash value in home insurance, how depreciation affects claims, and how to choose.

item.title: What Is Full Coverage Car Insurance?
item.description: "Full coverage" is not an official policy type. Learn what it usually includes, what it leaves out, and when it may make sense to drop it.
